lifecycle.note: Visibility classification does not change any source lifecycle status. Sources mapped here are PROPOSAL (campaign/playtest, campaign/rules, campaign/proposals, session0-redlines) or PLAYTESTABLE_DRAFT (aipt/p0-b000/premades-v2.json). Nothing in this file promotes any entity to CANON.

scope.note: First-slice sources expected by the later game-package manifest. Every path in first_slice_sources must have at least one applicable mapping below (whole-file or section/entity-level); a missing mapping fails closed.

aipt_metadata_out_of_scope.note: aipt/** operational metadata (status.json, stable-ids.json, this file, safety-profile.json, future manifest) is AIPT tooling metadata — not game content and not subject to player-visibility classification. Licensing classification (aipt/** = EXCLUDED_FROM_CONTENT_POLICY) is orthogonal to visibility classification.

PUBLIC.meaning: Freely publishable and player-visible with no confidentiality restriction. May live in the public repository and be shown to any principal at any time. A release note, when present, is presentation timing only (when the GM hands the material out at the table); it is never a principal-access override and never restricts the GM from accessing the same material.

UNRELEASED_REMOTE_ALLOWED.meaning: Player-facing content that must not reach ALL_PLAYERS before its release point, but may be transmitted remotely (to the GM / prep tooling / platform backend) ahead of time for preparation. The release field records the in-game point at which it becomes player-visible; it is a presentation-timing gate for ALL_PLAYERS only and never restricts GM access — the GM may access the same material at any time.

TABLE_HIDDEN_REMOTE_ALLOWED.meaning: Not table-wide content: visible only to the principals listed on the mapping (typically the GM; for a Secret, also its owning CHARACTER principal). Never shown to the whole table — ALL_PLAYERS is a hard-forbidden principal on any TABLE_HIDDEN_REMOTE_ALLOWED mapping. May be transmitted remotely to the GM and to any other listed principal for preparation.

LOCAL_ONLY_SECRET.meaning: Never transmitted remotely under any path. Kept only on local, non-remote storage. No instance may be packaged or referenced by the manifest.

HUMAN_PRIVATE_DATA.meaning: Participant responses and personal data (safety confirmations, session feedback, any answers/names/mental-health data). Never a formal game input. Never persisted in the public repository, never included in the manifest or packaged bundle, never sent to remote models by default. See aipt/p0-b001/safety-profile.json data_handling.

CREDENTIAL_SECRET.meaning: Actual credentials, tokens, keys, or secrets that unlock systems. Must never appear in this public repository, in the manifest, or in any packaged bundle. Declared absent here by policy; any future occurrence is a fail-closed rejection.

whole_file.meaning: covers the entire file from line 1 to the last line; no other mapping may overlap it for the same path

json_path.meaning: covers the JSON subtree addressed by the locator path

markdown_heading.meaning: covers the heading line plus its section body until the next heading of equal or higher level; with source.scope.heading_only=true covers only the heading line itself and never the subtree

markdown_table_column.meaning: covers one column of a markdown table, addressed by its containing heading plus the column header

markdown_preamble.meaning: covers the document front matter before the first level-2 (## ) section heading: from line 1 up to the last non-empty line before that heading (trailing blank lines excluded); the locator records the resolved inclusive line range {start_line, end_line}

overlap_resolution.deterministic_precedence: when two mappings for the same source path cover ranges of different specificity (e.g., preamble vs section, parent heading vs child heading, section vs table column), the narrower mapping deterministically governs its own range and the broader mapping covers only its remainder
overlap_resolution.equal_specificity_conflict: two mappings for the same source path whose effective ranges overlap with equal specificity must agree on label, remote_allowed, and principals; any disagreement is REJECTED (fail closed) — there is no permissive tie-break
overlap_resolution.declared_complementary_exclusion: a broader mapping may explicitly exclude a sub-range (source.scope.exclude_columns, source.scope.heading_only, or a markdown_preamble boundary) that a separate narrower mapping covers; the declared exclusion makes the pair complementary rather than conflicting

principals.note: Principals are game-owned entities only. GM is the game master seat; ALL_PLAYERS means any player at the table; CHARACTER:<UNR-CHAR-xxxx> references the stable character entity IDs registered in aipt/p0-b001/stable-ids.json (UNR-CHAR-0001 游隼 / 0002 短波 / 0003 静水 / 0004 底片). Principals are never runtime seat IDs and never identify human participants.
principals.player_facing_access: Every PUBLIC and UNRELEASED_REMOTE_ALLOWED mapping lists GM alongside ALL_PLAYERS: the GM always has access to the same player-facing material. A release note is presentation timing only (when ALL_PLAYERS may see the material) and is never a principal-access override for the GM.

fail_closed.note: Any mapping whose label is not one of the six taxonomy labels is rejected; any in-scope source without at least one applicable mapping is rejected; any manifest reference to a label absent from this taxonomy is rejected; any equal-specificity mapping overlap for the same source path that disagrees on label, remote_allowed, or principals is rejected (see policy.locators.overlap_resolution). There is no permissive fallback.

LOCAL_ONLY_SECRET.note: By definition local-only secrets are not stored in the repository. The label is declared for future use; any instance that would need to appear in the repo or manifest must instead be rejected.

HUMAN_PRIVATE_DATA.note: No participant answers, names, or mental-health data exist anywhere in this repository. Session-0 confirmations and any table feedback are classified HUMAN_PRIVATE_DATA (see safety-profile.json) and are never a formal game input, never persisted in the public game repo, and never sent to remote models by default.

CREDENTIAL_SECRET.note: No credential instances exist. Credentials must never appear in this public repository, in the manifest, or in any packaged bundle. Any occurrence is a fail-closed rejection (see fail_closed).

taxonomy_exact.rule: taxonomy.labels must be exactly the six labels PUBLIC, UNRELEASED_REMOTE_ALLOWED, TABLE_HIDDEN_REMOTE_ALLOWED, LOCAL_ONLY_SECRET, HUMAN_PRIVATE_DATA, CREDENTIAL_SECRET; any other label anywhere is rejected

remote_allowed_derived.rule: every mapping's remote_allowed must equal policy.taxonomy.remote_allowed[mapping.label]; mappings may not override the taxonomy

principal_layer.rule: every principal in every mapping is exactly GM, ALL_PLAYERS, or CHARACTER:<registered UNR-CHAR id> from aipt/p0-b001/stable-ids.json (UNR-CHAR-0001..0004); runtime seat IDs and participant identifiers are rejected

secret_principal_exact.rule: a mapping carrying entity_ids including UNR-SECRET-* must have principals exactly [GM, CHARACTER:<owning character>]; ALL_PLAYERS or any character other than the owner is rejected

table_hidden_never_all_players.rule: a mapping labeled TABLE_HIDDEN_REMOTE_ALLOWED is never table-wide: ALL_PLAYERS is forbidden in principals and the principals listed on the mapping are the only authorized viewers (e.g., GM, plus a Secret's owning CHARACTER principal)

locator_type_declared.rule: every mapping's source.locator_type must be one of the types declared in policy.locators.types (whole_file, json_path, markdown_heading, markdown_table_column, markdown_preamble); an undeclared locator type is rejected

conflicting_mappings.rule: no two mappings for the same source path may conflict: (a) an equal-specificity overlap must agree on label, remote_allowed, and principals or it is REJECTED; (b) different-specificity nesting resolves deterministically — the narrower mapping governs its own range and the broader mapping covers only the remainder; (c) declared complementary exclusions (source.scope.heading_only, source.scope.exclude_columns, markdown_preamble boundary) make a pair complementary rather than conflicting

credential_absent.rule: no mapping may use label CREDENTIAL_SECRET and no credential-like content may exist in the repository or manifest; presence is a fail-closed rejection

human_private_not_game_input.rule: label HUMAN_PRIVATE_DATA is never a formal game input; the manifest must never reference it as packaged content and no mapping may use it for a repository source

coverage.rule: every path in scope.first_slice_sources must be covered by at least one mapping (whole-file, preamble, or section/entity-level); a missing mapping is a fail-closed rejection
